annotations.title: Read what a monitor has seen

description: Read a monitor's history: its latest answer with evidence status and the last 20 events (baseline, change, error). Pass nextCursor as before for older events, or eventId to recover one exact event; do not combine them. Also returns monitor.runStatus for one current original slot: scheduled (future with no outstanding work), pending (work may still complete or publish), needs_review (reason result_unconfirmed or result_unavailable), or unknown (ambiguous evidence, including a recent stopped claim whose request ownership cannot be proved). Each object includes scheduledFor, the UTC millisecond due time; only needs_review includes reason. Stopped idle runStatus is null only with complete positive no-outstanding current-slot evidence. statusRead {coverage: complete, observedAt} covers the monitor/status database statement observation, not separately read events or fleet/history counts. Pending promises no running process, charge, completion time or recovery; review reasons imply neither refund, failed extraction nor semantic correctness. Snapshot failure is SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Reading does not change monitoring or accounting state; ordinary authentication and rate-limit effects apply. Every change carries the full before and after responses with evidence, and a diff of the fields that moved. Charges no credits. Requires authentication: sign in with your Contrie account (OAuth), or send an API key in the Authorization header.

before.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the latest 20 events

eventId.description: An exact retained event ID from this monitor or its webhook; do not combine with before
